title: Great Sitkin volcano May 3 — lava dome growth, elevated surface temps in satellite
snippet: Slow lava effusion continues within the Great Sitkin summit crater. Seismic data recording rockfalls from growing lava dome. Slightly elevated surface temperatures observed in satellite images. Aviation Color Code ORANGE. No significant ash emissions. Minor lava dome growth and rockfalls continuing along east and south sides of lava field.
tag_reason: 신규: 이전 14일 보고서에 Great Sitkin 관련 항목 없음. 위성 열이상 관측 확인.
